doc.title: Marshall Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 19, 2021

title: Pay and personal life under Sun Ra
summary: Sun Ra paid last, and Allen describes being given tasks that made him miss dates.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Wow. Was there any anticipation of like a weekly payday?

Payday? If you’re with Sun Ra you’re the last one to get paid. Everybody else get their regular dues and so you live in the house and you’re with Sun Ra, you know, so don’t be putting your hand out. That was one thing that used to upset me because I would need some money but I’d be part of that, you always wait, he has to pay each fella. © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
Oh that’s so interesting. I mean how could you have personal relationships? If you wanted to take someone out on a date, you know, and you didn’t have any bread?

If the date didn’t have none you might as well stay home. Because that’s the way it was. Any time you get a date he’d give you some work to do. And then you would probably be late for the date or don’t even make it. If he’d see you going out the door he’d go “Wait a minute, do this before you go.” And that “do this before you go” and two hours later you’re still there doing that before you go. And by that time it’s too late.
